source_name: ГИР БО — GIR BO (State Information Resource for Accounting Statements)
organization: Federal Tax Service of Russia (ФНС / FNS)
rate_limits: no key; public search + bfo API; annual bulk datasets
notes: Open financial-statements register + identity, free API (no key). Search by INN/OGRN/name returns identity (INN, OGRN, KPP, OKOPF legal form, OKFS ownership, OKPO, OKVED, region/address, status) + a list of filed annual statements (balance sheet form 1 + income statement form 2), RUB. Bulk datasets at /nbo/opendata. Verified live: Gazprom (7736050003, statements 2021-2025), Lukoil (7708004767). Banks excluded (file with the Central Bank).

source_name: РСМП — Unified Register of SMEs (FNS open data)
organization: Federal Tax Service of Russia (ФНС / FNS)
rate_limits: monthly bulk ZIP (~2.25 GB); XSD structure provided
notes: The Unified Register of Small and Medium Enterprises — open bulk XML (monthly, latest 10.06.2026 ~2.25 GB, XSD provided). Per entity: INN (ИННЮЛ), OGRN, full/short name, region (Регион/Район/Город/КодРегион), OKVED activity (СвОКВЭДОсн/Доп), SME category (КатСубМСП micro/small/medium), entity type (ВидСубМСП ЮЛ/ИП), date included (ДатаВклМСП), average headcount (ССЧР). Best open company list (~6M SMEs). XSD downloaded; full archive too large to fetch here.

source_name: ЕГРЮЛ — EGRUL (Unified State Register of Legal Entities)
organization: Federal Tax Service of Russia (ФНС / FNS)
rate_limits: free per-company extract (выписка); full bulk via paid FTP subscription
notes: The authoritative Unified State Register of Legal Entities. Free per-company extract (выписка, PDF) by OGRN/INN/name at egrul.nalog.ru. The FULL bulk (all legal entities, daily updates) is provided only via a PAID FTP subscription — no free open bulk. Holds directors/founders (personal data), capital, OKVED, full history. GIR BO + RSMP cover most fields openly; this for the authoritative full register. Cataloged from public docs.

source_name: FNS open data — formerly tax-secret company information
organization: Federal Tax Service of Russia (ФНС / FNS)
notes: Since 2016 the FNS publishes formerly-tax-secret information about all organizations as open datasets keyed on INN: average headcount (sshr), special tax regimes, income/expense from accounting statements (revexp), paid taxes (paidtax), tax arrears. Plus the register of disqualified persons (registerdisqualified) and the SME register (rsmp). Bulk XML/CSV at file.nalog.ru. Enrichment keyed on INN.
